name: development-time-coding-agent-governance
purpose: Guide human-admitted coding work through repository-grounded context, bounded implementation, fresh evidence, and completion reconciliation without taking semantic or transition authority.
triggers: A meaningful coding-agent task is requested or reaches a governed development checkpoint
The configured requirement, architecture, and functionality drift-review cadence becomes due
not_for: Mechanical runtime interruption or security enforcement
Approving semantic requirement or architecture correctness
Authorizing commit, merge, publication, release, deployment, or external writes

human_review.reason: Value, architecture, exceptions, semantic completion, and consequential transitions remain accountable human decisions.
